description: This Java class 'HonoCommander' is part of a testing framework that sends commands to IoT devices via the Hono platform and collects response metrics, integrating with JMeter for performance testing.

classes.name: HonoCommander
classes.description: Manages command communication with devices via Hono, including sending commands, receiving responses, and collecting metrics, designed for integration with JMeter for load testing.

methods.name: HonoCommander
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HonoCommander with sampler configuration and sets up client properties.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Establishes connection to Hono and creates message consumers; returns a CompletableFuture to indicate success or failure.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Performs a sampling cycle, sending commands to devices depending on trigger type, and records metrics.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes client connections and resources, returning a CompletableFuture when complete.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Creates a connection to Hono platform asynchronously.

methods.name: createMessageConsumers
methods.description: Sets up message consumers for event and telemetry data.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages from device or telemetry channels.

methods.name: handleCommandReadinessNotification
methods.description: Handles notifications about device readiness to receive commands.

methods.name: sendCommandAndReceiveResponse
methods.description: Sends a command to a specified device and handles the response.

methods.name: setSampleStartAndEndTime
methods.description: Records start and end times for sample measurement.

methods.name: setSampleStartIfNotSetYet
methods.description: Initializes the sample start timestamp if not already set.
